result.one_liner: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud accounting platform, exposing a REST Accounting API (v3) for invoices, payments, customers, and financial data.

evidence.quote: The QuickBooks API uses OAuth 2.0 exclusively — there are no API keys or basic authentication options.
Most recent QuickBooks Online apps will have OAuth 2.0 as their default authentication protocol.
create up to five sandbox companies per developer account

result.notes: Official developer.intuit.com pages are a JS-rendered SPA that WebFetch could not extract text from (returned only truncated shells) despite multiple attempts on get-started and OAuth2 docs pages; findings corroborated instead via Intuit's own GitHub SDK docs (intuit.github.io, an Intuit-owned domain) and a third-party developer guide, plus the deterministic unauth API probe confirming a live v3 REST endpoint requiring Bearer/OAuth2 tokens. No official Intuit MCP server found; only community MCP servers exist in the registry. API breadth estimated medium based on ~30+ accounting entities each supporting multiple CRUD/query operations (Composio wraps 114 tools over this API).
